patch_description: The prior failures came from division-by-zero when a GPU's used memory equals GPU_MEM_SIZE. The successful approaches used greedy assignment and threshold packing. My novel approach: (1) a safe greedy that assigns each model (sorted by pressure density descending) to the GPU minimizing the resulting KVPR, guarding against zero denominators; (2) a max-min local search phase that repeatedly takes the highest-KVPR GPU and tries moving (or swapping) a model to a lower-pressure GPU whenever it strictly reduces the maximum KVPR across all GPUs — a hill-climbing refinement the prior programs lacked. This keeps 100% success rate while lowering the max KVPR beyond pure greedy.
